definitions.full: H1901. hagig הָגִיג noun [masculine] murmuring (Che), whisper, musing (on form compare Ba NB 136 ) — only suffix הֲגִיגִי 1 Psa 5:2 ה ׳בִּינָה understand my murmuring (whispering, faint utterance), addressed to ׳י . 2 Psa 39:4 בַּהֲגִיגִי in my musing i.e. while I was musing. הַגֻּדְגֹּ֫דָה see below גדד p. 151.
